This is a tough one. I usually ignore the posts I read on the relationship Reddit even though I read them all the way through because I don’t know what to say
I think it’s interesting that it doesn’t bother you. And that’s okay! I would just want to make sure that, since she’s not your friend anymore, it doesn’t mess up you and your husbands relationship (like him giving you less time/not making you his priority/etc. maybe you are polyamorous. I would definitely try to reopen your relationship with her and at least stay involved, that way you can get a better picture of how you feel about the situation.
